# Maintenance alert photographs

Official photographs by Prusa Research illustrate CORE One / CORE One+ selftest checks and MMU3 Nextruder main-plate maintenance. The application displays the photographs with the matching instructions and a link to their actual article.

`SOURCES.json` records each local filename, original image URL, supplied image URL, article, section and file hash. Images are unchanged publisher-provided thumbnails, with an original image where a thumbnail was unavailable.

Photographs retain their owner's copyright and terms. They are separate from the application's code, CAD and firmware licences; this project assigns no new licence to the photographs.
